// Update these colors for changing color theming of app

export const Colors = {
  themeColor: "#00D09C",

  dark_background: "#121212",
  dark_background_light: "#252525",
  dark_text: "#FCFCFC",
  dark_text_light: "#FCFCFC",
  dark_border: "#484C56",
  dark_card: "#292929",

  active_tab: "#808EEE",
  unactive_tab: "#7C7D8B",

  noti_card_dark: "#1b1b1b",
  noti_card_light: "#f8f8f8",

  light_card: "#F9F9F9",
  light_background: "#FFF",
  light_sub_background: "#F8F8F8",
  light_border: "#ccc",
  light_text: "#454545",

  profit: "#0ABB93",
  loss: "#D55538",
  errorColor: "#eb5b3c",
};
